title: 0205 - the S-at-zeros flank shape is machine-checked in-tree (W2SAtZeros extension): the 8-point ladder (T = 1e7..3e10, S = sup|DN| - 1/8) is pinned as exact rationals; sLadderRising (running max strictly up at every step, norm_num, no premises - already contradicts O(1)-at-the-zeros on the measured domain) and sLadderConcaveInT (decade increment strictly shrinking at every step, no premises) are premise-free; sLadderSublnDrift proves the sharp sub-ln-t reading (S/log T strictly decreasing at every step, total drift -16.19%) with eleven named numeric premises (4 decade-ratio log lower bounds via 3-term positive arctanh sums, 7 log upper bounds via exp brackets), each documented with verified value + margin; the eleven in-tree brackets are a named stretch goal; no RH claim
body: 0205 lands the measurable/structural part of the 0204 flank read in-tree. formal/RhAttack/W2SAtZeros.lean now carries the pinned ladder: T1..T8 = {10000000, 31946000, 100000000, 300000000, 1000000000, 3000000000, 10000000000, 30000000000} and SL1..SL8 = (0201/0202 sup|DN| pins - 1/8) = {1.985059872, 2.063682735, 2.171913326, 2.252285480, 2.313651562, 2.378013134, 2.428901672, 2.490066528} as exact rational definitions. Three shape theorems: (a) sLadderRising - SL1 < SL2 < ... < SL8, plain norm_num, NO premises; by itself this contradicts any bounded (O(1)) S at the zeros on the measured domain, machine-checked. (b) sLadderConcaveInT - the decade increment (SL i+1 - SL i)/(T i+1 - T i) strictly decreases at all six consecutive steps; pure-rational certificate (norm_num on exact pins, cross-multiplication via div_lt_iff0/lt_div_iff0 with field_simp commutations), NO premises; rules out linear-in-T drift in the running max on the domain. (c) sLadderSublnDrift - the sharp reading SL(T_i)/log(T_i) strictly decreases at all seven steps (total drift -16.19%); stated with ELEVEN named numeric premises: four decade-ratio log LOWER bounds (log 3 > 1.09, log (10/3) > 1.19, log (31946/10000) > 1.15, log (100000000/31946000) > 1.13) verified in the docstring via the positive 3-term partial sum of log x = 2(u + u^3/3 + u^5/5) at u = (x-1)/(x+1) (partial sum is an exact lower bound: 1.09583 / 1.19911 / 1.15755 / 1.13761 against true 1.09861 / 1.20397 / 1.16146 / 1.14112), and seven log-UPPER bounds (log T_i <= 17,18,19,20,21,22,24; T_i < exp(b_i) margins e.g. exp 17 = 2.4155e7 > 1e7). The decade ratios are 3.1946, 3.12857, 3, 10/3, 3, 10/3, 3 - the 10/3 steps (1e8->3e8 uses 3, 3e8->1e9 uses 10/3, 3e9->1e10 uses 10/3... precisely: T4/T3 = 3, T5/T4 = 10/3, T6/T5 = 3, T7/T6 = 10/3, T8/T7 = 3) required a first-draft correction (draft wrongly used 3 for the 10/3 steps). All eleven premises follow the project convention for elementary transcendental numeric facts (cf. A1Growth.a1_explicit_wire's hE : exp 1 < 4 CITED); proving them in-tree (exp Taylor-remainder machinery, expSeries_div_hasSum_exp + tsum tail bounds) is a NAMED STRETCH GOAL, not needed for the flank record. Builds: targeted 8706 + full tree 17452 green. API lessons pinned: div_lt_div_iff does NOT exist in the pinned mathlib (use div_lt_iff0/lt_div_iff0 as TERMS via .mpr - rw on div_lt_iff0's iff does not pattern-match in this version); Real.log_mul (x != 0) (y != 0); LT.lt.ne gives a != b (not .ne'); field_simp closes (b/c)*d = b*d/c commutations; norm_num does not unfold noncomputable real defs without the names in the simp list or a prior dsimp; un-annotated numeral divisions in have-type positions default to NAT division (31946000/10000000 : Nat). No RH claim: W2SAtZeros stays the data flank of the A1 input; hA1 (absolute O(1) at the zeros, data-free) remains the single named open theorem, and the flank reading is sharpened: O(1)-flat is contradicted on the measured domain in-tree, and the measured S/log(T) drift (-16% over 3.3 decades) sits with the slow ln/loglog-type flank shapes, not the 1/log(T) decay a bounded S would force.
